correctness.rationale: Original RESULT.md gives incorrect displayed coefficient -210t for B5(t) in the meridional support radius; differentiation of P5 yields B5=(-105t+455t^3-378t^5)/2. Complete corrected RESULT.md bytes supplied; all final theorem hypotheses and boundaries re-assessed.
